title: cardamine californica proles cardiophylla
intro: Cardamine californica proles cardiophylla, commonly known as Western bittercress, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae) that is native to the western coast of North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Western bittercress include glucosinolates, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions may also include the potential to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress.
